title: An infinity-categorical TQFT from instantons
summary: In this paper, we lift the instanton TQFT from ordinary categories to the $\infty$-categorical setting by constructing a functor $CI:\mathrm{BI}^{\partial}\longrightarrow\mathsf{D}$ from an $\infty$-cobordism category $\mathrm{BI}^{\partial}$ for instantons to an $\infty$-derived category $\mathsf{D}$ of $2$-periodic chain complexes. The construction of $\mathrm{BI}^{\partial}$ is a modification of the $\infty$-cobordism category $\mathrm{Bord}_4$ introduced by Lurie and by Calaque--Scheimbauer using complete Segal spaces.
